Wings for Life World Run: Es gibt keine: Wings for Life World Run: there is no finish line. 30 minutes after the start the Catcher Car sets off at 14 km/h and gets faster every 30 minutes: 15, 16, 17, 18, then 22, 26, 30 and from 4:30 h 34 km/h. It is at km 7 after 1:00 h, km 14.5 after 1:30, km 22.5 after 2:00, km 31 after 2:30, km 40 after 3:00, km 51 after 3:30, km 64 after 4:00 and km 79 after 4:30 h.
Ziel in km eintragen: Die App rechnet, w: Enter the goal in km: the app calculates when the Catcher Car reaches that kilometre – that is your goal time, and from it the pace you need to run at least on average. Example 10 km: 7 km by 1:00 h, the last 3 km at 15 km/h take 12 min → 1:12:00 = 7:12 /km. Example 20 km: 1:50:38 = 5:32 /km. Run evenly – the car only gets really fast late.
Wie weit deine Form reicht: die Strecke,: How far your form takes you: the distance where your Riegel prediction takes exactly as long as the Catcher Car to get there. Example 10 km in 55:00 → about 18 km. Beyond marathon length rather too optimistic.
Pace Race: Runden über 1.000 m, jede mit: Pace Race: laps of 1,000 m, each with a time limit – level 1 8:00 min, level 2 7:00, level 3 6:30, level 4 6:15, level 5 6:00, then each lap 10 sec faster up to level 28 at 2:10. The next lap starts 60 sec after the time limit: the faster you run, the longer your break. Your level is the number of laps you complete.
Welches Level deine Form hergibt, schätz: The app roughly estimates which level your form allows: the last level whose time limit is not faster than your 5 km race pace – after many laps more is rarely possible. Example 10 km in 55:00 → 5 km pace 5:17 → about level 9. Because of the breaks a Pace Race result does not belong under Best times – it would skew the training paces.
Neu bei den Rennen: Wings for Life World: New for races: Wings for Life World Run with a goal in km. From the Catcher Car’s speed the app calculates when it catches you there and from that your minimum pace – plus roughly how far your form takes you.
Neu bei den Rennen: Pace Race mit Ziel-L: New for races: Pace Race with a goal level. The app shows the time limit of the goal lap and plans 1 km repeats with 60 sec breaks up to level pace.
Ziel-Level eintragen: Level 12 heißt 12: Enter the goal level: level 12 means 12 km and lap 12 in at most 4:50 – that is your level pace. All 12 laps with breaks take about 1:22 h. The plan treats it like a custom distance of that many km; in the build-up, specific phase and taper, quality and long run get 1 km repeats with 60 sec standing rest up to level pace. As with race pace, your form counts: if level pace is faster than your current 5 km pace, the plan uses your 5 km pace for now.

Liegen zwei A-Rennen dicht beieinander,: If two A races are close together, the second block is shortened at the front – the foundation first. If both are of the same kind (e.g. half marathon and Wings for Life over 20 km), the preparation simply counts for both.

Zu dicht sind zwei A-Rennen, wenn das zw: Two A races are too close if the second falls into the recovery after the first or the first into the taper before the second – e.g. a half marathon and a marathon one week later. Plan and race form show this as a warning: enter one of them as a B race. A B race during recovery or taper just runs along easily.
Liegen zwei A-Rennen nah beieinander, be: If two A races are close together, the plan prepares both together: before that every second quality session is already for the later race, long run and weekly km follow the longer one. If an A race falls into the recovery after another or into its taper, plan and race form warn – better make one of them a B race. B races during recovery just run along easily.
Beim Öffnen zeigt die App kurz Icon, Nam: When opening, the app briefly shows its icon, name and version – only until it is ready, and not during a running workout. A tap hides it right away.
„Heute dabei“ heißt jetzt „Geräte“ und g: “With me today” is now called “Equipment” and applies per plan: e.g. full body with kettlebell and body weight, Tabata kettlebell only, runner with band. Every plan remembers its choice, and it is synced with your other devices. Until you change a plan, your previous choice applies.
Profil → Geräte & Gewichte → Urlaub von–: Profile → Equipment & weights → Holiday from–until: during this time all plans are preset to body weight only, AMRAP and Core are hidden. Equipment switched on during the holiday only applies there; afterwards your equipment per plan applies again.
Unter „Geräte“ und auf der Startseite be: Under “Equipment” and on the home screen next to the strength entry you see what to get ready for the plan – from the exercises it currently uses: kettlebell with weight, bands, a mat for exercises on the floor, a chair or sofa for support.
Wings for Life und Pace Race haben unter: Wings for Life and Pace Race have their own tabs under best times: furthest distance and best level, with improvement and all results.
Unter Profil → Herzfrequenz lässt sich d: Under Profile → Heart rate you can estimate your max HR if there is no test value yet: with Tanaka and Nes instead of “220 − age”. A measured value can still be entered directly and is always more accurate.
Ab dem Tag nach einem A- oder B-Rennen f: From the day after an A or B race the home screen asks for your time and saves it as a result – the training paces adjust afterwards. For Wings for Life you enter the km you reached (the time comes from the Catcher Car), for the Pace Race the level. The question stays until you enter the result or choose “Did not run”.
Ab dem Tag nach einem geplanten Lauf (Qu: From the day after a planned run (quality, running group, long run) the home screen asks for the km you ran, so the weekly km are right. The question stays until you enter the km or choose “Did not run” (the session is skipped). If several are open, the oldest is on top and the others are collapsed.
Ergebnisse aus Rennen und Bestzeiten zäh: Results from races and best times count towards your weekly km and longest run automatically – on days without an entered run, from your first entered run on, and not in weeks with their own weekly total. If you enter a run for that day, only that one counts.
Im Profil unter Trainingswoche gibt es j: Under Profile → Training week there are now up to four other sessions, each with day and type: easy run, recovery run (very easy, 20–40 min, zone 1), second quality session (the other session of the week, easy during recovery and taper) or other such as cycling or a class. Runs count for catching up and logging; the plan warns about two hard days in a row. Your previous other session is carried over.
Beim Nachtragen auf der Startseite kanns: When logging a run on the home screen you can add time and average heart rate. The app then shows whether pace and heart rate were in the recommended range (easy: zone 2 and your easy pace, recovery: zone 1) and gives a tip for next time. Interval and tempo sessions are not rated because the average says little there.
Bei jedem B-Rennen steht, was es in der: Every B race now says what it replaces that week and how to run it: it replaces the quality session, from half marathon or long-run length also the long run. A much shorter race (e.g. 10 km in a marathon block) you race as your speed session, otherwise it is a fitness test. During recovery and taper: easy, not for time.
Auf Android lädt „In Datei sichern“ die: On Android “Save to file” now downloads the backup straight to the “Downloads” folder – depending on the device, the share menu there has no option to save on the device.
Aus einem Code-Review: Zurücksetzen der: From a code review: resetting the test version leaves the real app alone, the app only cleans up its own offline data, sync copes with a device clock that is off, a backup from a newer version loses nothing on import, and impossible dates like 31 Feb are rejected.
Download gestartet – die Sicherung liegt: Download started – the backup will be in your “Downloads” folder.
Unter „Heute dran“ trägst du den Lauf de: Under “On today” you log the day’s run right away – with time and average heart rate if you like. Open runs and races from earlier now show the newest first, and each card says which day it asks about (“yesterday”, “3 days ago”).
Auch unter Laufen → Umfang → Lauf eintra: Under Running → Volume → Add a run there are now time, average heart rate and the type of run (otherwise from the plan) – with the same review as on the home screen.
